evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant337_entry.c: matching french_model_variant/variant337_entry.c: the loader entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame and calls its helpers; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-320 images (models 110, 159 and 410) build these sources directly (the entry through model_variant/variant320_entry.c with MODEL_VARIANT337_CLUT_X 512), the French header-337/487 images through the VERSION_FRENCH ribbon and streamer wrappers, and the Spanish images directly; each image binds the names at its own addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
